model.name: qwen3.8-27b
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.8, 27B dense, FP8 as published by Qwen. Thinking mode off, so it answers directly like gpt-oss at low reasoning effort. Apache-2.0. A hybrid (linear-attention) model: vLLM's default of 256 sequences exceeds its state cache on a 48 GB card, hence --max-num-seqs 64.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, j.display_name;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON t.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC, b.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    cc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category cc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = cc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY cc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, cc.display_name;

WITH filtered_rates AS (
    SELECT
        f.currency_code,
        f.average_rate
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND f.average_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    currency_code,
    AVG(average_rate) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM filtered_rates
GROUP BY currency_code
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH latest_market AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_key)
        market_key,
        display_name
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_market
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
    ORDER BY market_key, effective_from_date DESC
)
SELECT
    lm.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(fv.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily fv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fv.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN latest_market lm
    ON fv.market_key = lm.market_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY lm.display_name
ORDER BY lm.display_name;

SELECT
    a.account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account AS a
WHERE a.opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_type_code
ORDER BY a.account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY b.city_name;

SELECT
    AVG(fab.closing_balance_amount) AS average_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily fab
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fab.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.mid_rate) AS average_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12
  AND c.iso_alpha_code = 'USD';

SELECT
    d.month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.month_number
ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY customer_segment_code
ORDER BY customer_segment_code;

WITH customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    WHERE c.effective_from_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.effective_to_date IS NULL OR c.effective_to_date >= DATE '2025-01-01')
),
transacted_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction t
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers_2025 c
WHERE c.customer_key NOT IN (SELECT customer_key FROM transacted_2025);

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        fa.payment_status_code
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON fa.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS declined_percentage
FROM base;

SELECT
    ccc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category ccc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = ccc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fc.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY ccc.display_name
ORDER BY ccc.display_name;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON t.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name
ORDER BY c.display_name;

SELECT
    SUM(d.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE d.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
  ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE a.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY j.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fdl.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily fdl
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fdl.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND fdl.days_past_due > 90;

WITH mobile_channel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT channel_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_channel
    WHERE LOWER(display_name) LIKE '%mobile app%'
)
SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN mobile_channel mc
    ON f.channel_key = mc.channel_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT wt.customer_key) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
  ON wt.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON wt.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND wt.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND dc.customer_segment_code = 'SME';

WITH branch_atm_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.region_code
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.display_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction t
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
        ON t.branch_key = b.branch_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
        ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM branch_atm_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.merchant_key,
        fa.original_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON fa.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
),
merchant_totals AS (
    SELECT
        m.merchant_category_code,
        SUM(a.original_amount) AS total_authorization_amount
    FROM auth_2025 a
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
      ON a.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
    WHERE m.merchant_category_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
)
SELECT
    merchant_category_code,
    total_authorization_amount
FROM merchant_totals
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC, merchant_category_code ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        c.business_id,
        SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
      ON w.customer_key = c.customer_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY c.business_id
)
SELECT
    business_id,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    wt.currency_code,
    SUM(wt.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY wt.currency_code
ORDER BY wt.currency_code;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction at
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON at.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wc.customer_key) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers wc
JOIN atm_customers ac ON wc.customer_key = ac.customer_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

UPDATE bank_dwh.dim_customer
SET customer_segment_code = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE city_name = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND is_current = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    c.currency_name AS currency_name,
    SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON w.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.iso_alpha_code,
    c.currency_name
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, j.display_name;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON t.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC, b.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    cc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category cc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = cc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY cc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, cc.display_name;

WITH fx_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.currency_key,
        f.business_date_key,
        f.average_rate
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND f.average_rate IS NOT NULL
),
daily_avg AS (
    SELECT
        currency_key,
        business_date_key,
        AVG(average_rate) AS daily_avg_rate
    FROM fx_2025
    GROUP BY currency_key, business_date_key
)
SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    c.currency_name,
    AVG(d.daily_avg_rate) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM daily_avg d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON d.currency_key = c.currency_key
GROUP BY c.iso_alpha_code, c.currency_name
ORDER BY c.iso_alpha_code;

WITH latest_market AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_key)
           market_key,
           display_name
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_market
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
    ORDER BY market_key, effective_from_date DESC
)
SELECT
    m.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(v.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily v
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON v.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN latest_market m
  ON v.market_key = m.market_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY m.display_name
ORDER BY m.display_name;

SELECT
    a.account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account AS a
WHERE a.opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_type_code
ORDER BY a.account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY b.city_name;

SELECT
    AVG(f.closing_balance_amount) AS average_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.mid_rate) AS average_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12
  AND c.iso_alpha_code = 'USD';

SELECT
    d.month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.month_number
ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY customer_segment_code
ORDER BY customer_segment_code;

WITH customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    WHERE c.effective_from_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.effective_to_date IS NULL OR c.effective_to_date >= DATE '2025-01-01')
),
transacted_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction t
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers_2025 c
WHERE c.customer_key NOT IN (SELECT customer_key FROM transacted_2025);

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        fa.payment_status_code
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON fa.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS declined_percentage
FROM base;

SELECT
    cc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category cc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = cc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fc.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY cc.display_name
ORDER BY cc.display_name;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON t.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name
ORDER BY c.display_name;

SELECT
    SUM(d.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE d.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
WHERE a.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY j.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.days_past_due > 90;

WITH mobile_channel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT channel_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_channel
    WHERE LOWER(display_name) LIKE '%mobile app%'
)
SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN mobile_channel mc
    ON f.channel_key = mc.channel_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wt.customer_key) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer dc
  ON wt.customer_key = dc.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON wt.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dc.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
  AND wt.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND dd.calendar_year_number = 2025;

WITH branch_atm_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.region_code
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.display_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
        ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
        ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM branch_atm_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH merchant_category_codes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT merchant_category_code
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_merchant
    WHERE merchant_category_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    mcc.merchant_category_code,
    SUM(ca.original_amount) AS total_card_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization ca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON ca.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
    ON ca.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
JOIN merchant_category_codes mcc
    ON m.merchant_category_code = mcc.merchant_category_code
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY mcc.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_card_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_key,
        c.business_id,
        SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
      ON w.customer_key = c.customer_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        c.customer_key,
        c.business_id
)
SELECT
    business_id,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC,
    business_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    wt.currency_code,
    SUM(wt.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY wt.currency_code
ORDER BY wt.currency_code;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction at
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON at.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wc.customer_key) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers wc
JOIN atm_customers ac ON wc.customer_key = ac.customer_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

UPDATE bank_dwh.dim_customer
SET customer_segment_code = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE city_name = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND is_current = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    c.currency_name AS currency_name,
    SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON w.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.iso_alpha_code,
    c.currency_name
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
    ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, j.display_name;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON t.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC, b.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    cc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category cc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = cc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY cc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, cc.display_name;

WITH fx_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.currency_key,
        f.business_date_key,
        f.mid_rate
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND f.mid_rate IS NOT NULL
),
daily_avg AS (
    SELECT
        currency_key,
        business_date_key,
        AVG(mid_rate) AS avg_daily_rate
    FROM fx_2025
    GROUP BY currency_key, business_date_key
)
SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    c.currency_name,
    ROUND(AVG(da.avg_daily_rate), 8) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM daily_avg da
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON da.currency_key = c.currency_key
GROUP BY c.iso_alpha_code, c.currency_name
ORDER BY c.iso_alpha_code;

WITH latest_market AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_key) market_key, display_name
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_market
    WHERE is_current = TRUE
    ORDER BY market_key, effective_from_date DESC
)
SELECT
    lm.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(fv.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily fv
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fv.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN latest_market lm
    ON fv.market_key = lm.market_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY lm.display_name
ORDER BY lm.display_name;

SELECT
    a.account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account AS a
WHERE a.opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_type_code
ORDER BY a.account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name AS city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY b.city_name;

SELECT
    AVG(fab.closing_balance_amount) AS average_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily fab
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fab.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.mid_rate) AS average_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.currency_code = 'USD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12;

SELECT
    d.month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.month_number
ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY customer_segment_code
ORDER BY customer_segment_code;

WITH customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer c
    WHERE c.effective_from_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND (c.effective_to_date IS NULL OR c.effective_to_date >= DATE '2025-01-01')
),
active_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction t
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers_2025 c
WHERE c.customer_key NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM active_customers_2025
);

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        fca.payment_status_code
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
      ON fca.business_date_key = dd.date_key
    WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS declined_percentage
FROM base;

SELECT
    cc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category cc
  ON fc.complaint_category_key = cc.complaint_category_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fc.is_escalated = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY cc.display_name
ORDER BY cc.display_name;

SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON t.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.display_name
ORDER BY c.display_name;

SELECT
    SUM(d.transaction_amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE d.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    j.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction j
  ON a.jurisdiction_key = j.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON a.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE a.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY j.display_name
ORDER BY j.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fdl.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily fdl
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fdl.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND fdl.days_past_due > 90;

WITH mobile_channel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT channel_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_channel
    WHERE LOWER(display_name) LIKE '%mobile app%'
)
SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN mobile_channel mc
    ON f.channel_key = mc.channel_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT wt.customer_key) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  ON wt.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND wt.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND c.customer_segment_code = 'SME';

WITH branch_atm_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.region_code
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.display_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
        ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
        ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        b.region_code,
        b.display_name
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM branch_atm_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.merchant_key,
        fa.original_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON fa.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT
    m.merchant_category_code,
    SUM(a.original_amount) AS total_card_authorization_amount
FROM auth_2025 a
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
  ON a.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_card_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_key,
        c.business_id,
        SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
      ON w.customer_key = c.customer_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        c.customer_key,
        c.business_id
)
SELECT
    business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM customer_totals
ORDER BY
    total_wire_amount DESC,
    business_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    wt.currency_code,
    SUM(wt.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY wt.currency_code
ORDER BY wt.currency_code;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON wt.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction at
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
      ON at.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wc.customer_key) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers wc
JOIN atm_customers ac
  ON wc.customer_key = ac.customer_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

UPDATE bank_dwh.dim_customer
SET customer_segment_code = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE city_name = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND is_current = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    c.currency_name AS currency_name,
    SUM(w.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer w
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON w.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
  ON w.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.iso_alpha_code,
    c.currency_name
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;
